channel.title: North Wales Pioneer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Pioneer (northwalespioneer.co.uk)

item.title: A Christmas Carol to be brought to life by Llandudno Town Band
item.description: Llandudno Town Band is set to deliver a free festive treat with a free concert performance of A Christmas Carol, narrated by Greg Patmore.

item.title: NHS flu and COVID vaccine clinics in North Wales this week
item.description: All adults eligible for an NHS flu or Autumn COVID-19 vaccine can drop in to one of our community clinics to get a jab without an appointment from Monday December 8.

item.title: Youngster who was homeless at 16 writes song to celebrate support he received
item.description: A youngster who found himself homeless at 16 has written a song to celebrate the support he received.

item.title: When to get yellow sticker Christmas bargains: Lidl, Aldi, M&S, Tesco and Sainsbury's
item.description: Bargain hunters who leave their festive food shopping until Christmas Eve can save a packet, say experts, but are you brave enough to risk bare shelves?

item.title: Llandudno Junction man, 22, one of six charged with multiple drug offences
item.description: A man from Llandudno Junction is one of six men who have been charged with a spate of drug offences in North Wales.

item.title: Conwy: Plans for dental practice and 'collaboration café' at Bodlondeb offices
item.description: A dental practice and café could open at the former council offices at Bodlondeb in Conwy.

item.title: Han & Fran and co-stars 'excited' for opening night of Cinderella panto in Llandudno
item.description: The Cinderella pantomime will open at Venue Cymru tomorrow night (December 12) and we spoke to some of the stars ahead of its opening.

item.title: River Island in Llandudno not included in list of 33 stores to be closed
item.description: Llandudno's River Island store has not been included on the list of 33 to be closed by the high street chain.

item.title: Conwy Council to investigate mega-Airbnb that sleeps 34 at former church
item.description: A 13-bedroom “six star” luxury Airbnb hosting “family gatherings and parties” for up to 34 people is being investigated by Conwy County Council.

item.title: Ruth Jones enjoys festive magic of Kate Rusby’s Christmas show in Llandudno
item.description: Gavin and Stacey writer and actor Ruth Jones shared her delight after spending a sparkling evening at Venue Cymru in Llandudno, soaking up the festive magic of Kate Rusby’s 20th anniversary Christmas tour.
